# SiftedTools

> Independent editorial comparator of the best AI tools for e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, DTC), published in French, English, Spanish and German. Every comparison is based on first-hand testing on real stores and on proprietary AI-visibility data (Quotis GEO Barometer). Not a directory: we sift and we give a verdict.

## About
- Editorial source, not an exhaustive directory: we rank on merit and commit to a verdict.
- Full transparency on affiliate links; rankings are never influenced by commissions.
- Author: Marvin Munos, 15 years in retail and e-commerce, operates his own Shopify stores, personally tests every tool.
- Every page carries a "Verified on" date and is re-checked regularly.
- Exclusive signal: the Quotis GEO Barometer, a monthly measurement of which tools ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Mistral actually recommend.
- Every content page is also available as clean Markdown by appending `.md` to the slug (e.g. /en/best-ai-tools-ecommerce.md).
